segments.name: insurance
segments.description: Writes insurance policies for businesses and individuals through its subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: We classify our businesses into three underwriting segments: insurance, reinsurance and mortgage.

segments.name: reinsurance

segments.evidence: We classify our businesses into three underwriting segments: insurance, reinsurance and mortgage.

revenueModel.text: Insureds and reinsureds pay premiums, and the reinsurance group pays brokers fees on premiums written.
revenueModel.evidence: Our reinsurance group generally pays brokerage fees to brokers based on negotiated percentages of the premiums written through such brokers.
